title: TapNumber follows the active regulator
symptom: On IEEE 13, a RegControl ActiveClass walk returned 9, 9 and 9 through OpenDSSDirect.py TapNumber(). Named queries returned 9, 6 and 9.
cause: The RegControls proxy reads its active control. In OpenDSSDirect.py the one-argument form writes the active control's tap.
safe_fix: In both classic interfaces query ? RegControl.<name>.TapNum and parse the text result. In AltDSS read TapNum on each RegControl object.
diagnostic_evidence: ActiveClass order reg1, reg2, reg3 returned 9, 9, 9 via RegControls.TapNumber().
Named text queries returned 9, 6, 9.
With reg2 explicitly selected, TapNumber(7) returned None and changed its tap from 6 to 7 in the test context.

tested.environment: Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, backend 0.14.5, opendssdirect.py 0.9.4, 2026-11-22

title: DSS-Python Text.Command is a string property
cause: DSS-Python exposes Command as a string property and Commands as the command-block method.
safe_fix: Set dss.Text.Command = "Solve" or call dss.Text.Commands("Solve"). In OpenDSSDirect.py use odd.Text.Command("Solve").
diagnostic_evidence: TypeError: 'str' object is not callable.
Text.Command assignment redirected the fixture. Text.Commands("Solve") converged.

title: DSS-Python solution lives on the active circuit
symptom: The DSS-Python IDSS object raised AttributeError when accessed as dss.Solution.
cause: The DSS-Python wrapper exposes the active circuit on the IDSS instance and attaches its solution interface to that circuit.
safe_fix: Access dss.ActiveCircuit.Solution in DSS-Python. Read the tool's interface-specific mapping before moving a call across wrappers.
diagnostic_evidence: AttributeError: 'IDSS' object has no attribute 'Solution'.
type(dss.ActiveCircuit.Solution).__name__ returned ISolution.

title: Total iteration accessor spelling differs by wrapper
symptom: DSS-Python raised AttributeError for Solution.TotalIterations, although that spelling works as a method in OpenDSSDirect.py.
cause: DSS-Python retains the COM-style Totaliterations property spelling.
safe_fix: Read dss.ActiveCircuit.Solution.Totaliterations for DSS-Python, odd.Solution.TotalIterations() for OpenDSSDirect.py, and ctx.Solution.TotalIterations for AltDSS.
diagnostic_evidence: AttributeError: 'ISolution' object has no attribute 'TotalIterations'.
DSS-Python Totaliterations and OpenDSSDirect.py TotalIterations() both returned 2 on the IEEE 13 snapshot.

title: DSS-Python ActiveClass.First is an integer property
cause: Reading First in DSS-Python activates the first member and returns its index. OpenDSSDirect.py exposes a callable First.
safe_fix: Use dss.ActiveCircuit.ActiveClass.First in DSS-Python and odd.ActiveClass.First() in OpenDSSDirect.py. Use explicit full names for per-element snapshot reads.
diagnostic_evidence: TypeError: 'int' object is not callable.
First and First() each returned 1 for the RegControl active class when used on their respective interfaces.

title: Losses returns W/var alongside kW/kvar power accessors
symptom: On IEEE 13 Line.650632, raw Losses values were 60,728.50 W and 195,986.08 var while TotalPowers returned terminal kW/kvar pairs.
cause: The engine returns Losses in W/var and TotalPower or TotalPowers in kW/kvar.
safe_fix: Divide both Losses components by 1,000 before comparing on a kW/kvar basis. For feeder dissipation use the circuit loss total.
diagnostic_evidence: odd.CktElement.Losses() returned [60728.5028021296,195986.0785571934] W/var.
The terminal sum matched converted losses [60.728502802129604,195.9860785571934] kW/kvar to 1e-8 absolute.

title: A controlled solve can move a manually written tap
symptom: IEEE 13 reg2 read back tap 5 immediately after the write, then moved to tap 6 after a Static solve.
cause: A controlled solve samples the enabled regulator and applies a tap change as needed for its setpoint.
safe_fix: Read TapNum after the selected solve path. For a single fixed-tap AltDSS solve call Solution.SolveNoControl(). To suppress all controls for subsequent solves, set ControlMode=Off and restore the desired mode afterward.
diagnostic_evidence: TapNum was 5 after the write and 6 after Solution.Solve().
A second tap-5 write followed by Solution.SolveNoControl() kept tap 5 with Static still selected.

title: Out-of-range local PTPhase reads back as 1
symptom: Writing PTPhase=7 to the locally sensing IEEE 13 reg2 read back 1 in both DSS text and AltDSS.
cause: For local winding sensing, the engine resets a positive voltage-buffer index above the monitored phase count to 1.
safe_fix: For local sensing select a positive buffer index from 1 through the monitored winding's phase count, or use min/max where appropriate. Read the applied value back after editing.
diagnostic_evidence: Edit RegControl.reg2 PTPhase=7, then ? RegControl.reg2.PTPhase returned 1.
The AltDSS typed getter also returned 1.

title: The Capacitor wrapper has no Spectrum field
symptom: Spectrum lookup is absent on Capacitor in both tested wrappers. The corresponding Load accessors expose Spectrum.
cause: The capacitor element property table omits Spectrum.
safe_fix: Use the capacitor property catalog when editing a bank. Assign Spectrum only to element classes that expose it.
diagnostic_evidence: hasattr(dss.ActiveCircuit.Capacitors, 'Spectrum') was False and hasattr(dss.ActiveCircuit.Loads, 'Spectrum') was True.
The pinned AltDSS Capacitor and Load object getters had the same capability split.

title: Default classic contexts can share circuit and cursor state
symptom: An empty AltDSS context could not see IEEE 13 in another context. The default OpenDSSDirect.py and DSS-Python objects saw and changed the same circuit.
cause: AltDSS NewContext creates an isolated engine context. The default classic surfaces can reference a common context in one process.
safe_fix: Initialize the circuit in the context you will query. For side-by-side wrapper comparisons, use a separate subprocess for each interface.
diagnostic_evidence: One AltDSS context had 38 elements. Reading NumCircuitElements in a second empty context raised (#8888) There is no active circuit! Create a circuit and retry.
The default DSS-Python circuit name was visible through odd.Circuit.Name(), and the load created through odd appeared in DSS-Python's AllElementNames.
A second New Circuit in the shared context raised (#266) Warning: Duplicate new element definition: "Vsource.source". Element being redefined.

title: LoadShape.new creates a shape when one already has that name
symptom: After a DSS text declaration of LoadShape.s1 with NPts=3, ctx.LoadShape.new("s1") created a blank same-named object.
cause: The new method is an object constructor. The pinned probe permitted the bare duplicate in this circuit.
safe_fix: Fetch an existing object with ctx.LoadShape[name]. Use new for initial creation and choose unique shape names.
diagnostic_evidence: Same-name objects enumerated NPts values [3,0].
The bare constructor returned 0 points. Name lookup returned 3 points.

title: LoadShape construction uses lowercase new
cause: The AltDSS ILoadShape collection exposes a lowercase new method.
safe_fix: Call ctx.LoadShape.new(...) or submit DSS text New LoadShape.<name> ... through ctx.Commands.
diagnostic_evidence: AttributeError: 'ILoadShape' object has no attribute 'New'.
callable(ctx.LoadShape.new) was True.

title: A missing LoadShape CSV fails at the file assignment
symptom: Creating a LoadShape with CSVFile pointing to a nonexistent file raised DSS error #613 during the command.
cause: CSVFile assignment invokes the engine's input-file loader. It raises when the file cannot be opened.
safe_fix: Resolve the path from the command's working directory or use a valid absolute path, then define the shape with the expected point count and file format.
diagnostic_evidence: (#613) Error opening file: "phase45_missing_loadshape.csv"
A fresh empty shape's CSVFile getter returned an empty string.

title: Empty LoadShape statistics can leave a pending error
symptom: A fresh empty shape returned an empty CSVFile string. Reading Mean returned zero, then the next CSVFile read raised #61107.
cause: Mean lazily evaluates the shape data. The pinned getter returns a value with the error pending until a checked wrapper call.
safe_fix: Populate the sample data before reading computed Mean or StdDev. If a checked getter reports #61107, inspect the previous statistics access and retry after providing data.
diagnostic_evidence: Fresh CSVFile was empty. Mean returned 0.0.
(#61107) LoadShape has no data to be normalized. Check for previous errors.
After the error was consumed, CSVFile again returned an empty string.

tested.environment: Windows 11 AMD64, Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, backend 0.14.5, opendssdirect.py 0.9.4, 2026-11-22

title: PMult typed writes require exactly NPts samples
symptom: PMult edits before sizing, with too few values, and with too many values all raised #20200425.
cause: The typed engine setter checks the input count against the shape's configured size.
safe_fix: Set NPts before writing the samples and supply a complete array of exactly that length. Use a fully sized replacement object when growing a populated shape.
diagnostic_evidence: (#20200425) LoadShape.length.PMult: Invalid number of elements. Expected 0 elements, got 2.
(#20200425) LoadShape.full.PMult: Invalid number of elements. Expected 4 elements, got 2.
(#20200425) LoadShape.full.PMult: Invalid number of elements. Expected 4 elements, got 5.
Rejected edits preserved PMult [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0].

title: NPts alone does not create sample values
symptom: On a fresh LoadShape, setting NPts to 4 left PMult empty until its first full write.
cause: NPts sets the count. The virgin shape has no allocated P sample array, so its getter returns an empty array.
safe_fix: For a fresh shape set NPts and write all samples before solving. To increase the size of a populated shape, create a new shape and reassign the load before reading or solving.
diagnostic_evidence: After NPts=4 on a blank shape, PMult was an empty float64 array.
After the first full write, PMult returned [1,2,3,4].
